Player.title: Playback
Player.unavailable: This source cannot be played in the browser.
Player.error: Could not play this video. Check your connection and browser compatibility.
Player.unsupported: Format not supported by this browser.
Player.sourceDetail: The source did not provide a playable link. Check your connection and provider authorization.
Player.formatDetail: The browser could not play the delivered media. Check the selected format (HLS or TS) and codec support.
Player.networkDetail: The media request failed. Network, CORS, denied access, server downtime or a segment are possible; the browser cannot identify which here.
Player.manifestDetail: The stream manifest could not be loaded or parsed. Check the link and format with the source.
Player.decodeDetail: The browser could not decode the received media; codec or corrupt data may be involved.
Player.unknownDetail: The exact cause is unknown. Check the source, network and browser compatibility.
Player.movePlayer: Move window (drag or use arrow keys)
Player.resizePlayer: Resize window (drag or use arrow keys)
Player.externalUnavailable: External window is unavailable in this browser or for this stream.
Player.playingInMini: Playing in the mini player. Select a channel to switch.
Player.accessDetail: The server rejected this stream (HTTP 401/403). Check that the trial is still active and your provider allows playback on this device.
Player.missingDetail: The stream is no longer available at this address (HTTP 404). Refresh the catalog or contact the provider.
